fields.label: Workflow
fields.description: The campaign this journey is running.

fields.label: Workflow Version
fields.description: The published version this journey follows. It is fixed at the start, so editing the campaign never re-routes a journey already running.

fields.label: Subject DocType
fields.description: The kind of record this journey is about.

fields.label: Subject Name
fields.description: The record this journey is about.

fields.label: State (JSON)
fields.description: Everything the journey has gathered so far, which every step reads and writes.

fields.label: Status
fields.description: Running, Parked, Done, Failed or Stopped. Stopped is deliberate - the patient left, so the journey was ended rather than allowed to fail.

fields.label: Stop Reason
fields.description: Why a stopped journey was ended.

fields.label: Resume At
fields.description: When a waiting journey becomes due.

fields.label: Awaiting Event
fields.description: The event a waiting journey is waiting for.

fields.label: Awaiting Correlation
fields.description: The token that ties a waiting step to the exact event that should wake it.

fields.label: Retry Count
fields.description: The number of times a step has been retried after a temporary failure.

fields.label: Active Key
fields.description: Held while the journey is live, so the same patient cannot run this campaign twice at once.

fields.label: Trigger DocType
fields.description: The kind of record whose save started this journey. The patient is always the subject; this is what actually fired.

fields.label: Trigger Name
fields.description: The record whose save started this journey. Blank when the patient's own record started it.
